title: Camouflage Clip Party Booth
oneLiner: A friendslop-style party toy where players draw camouflage rules on a room photo, hide, fail loudly, and export a shareable challenge card.
previewUrl: pending Stitch export in Phase B
targetUser: Friends, streamers, and event hosts who want a 15-second rule party game that produces funny failure clips.
keyUx: Upload or choose a room photo, paint legal hiding zones and forbidden colors, start a round timer, then grade how visible each player is and export a clip-card challenge.
spread_trigger: The whole point is showing the failed hiding attempt as a clip or challenge poster that friends can copy.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive web app called "Camouflage Clip Party Booth" for Friends, streamers, and event hosts who want a 15-second rule party game that produces funny failure clips.. The app is based on observed user pull from S15: A simple hide-and-seek camouflage rule, low price, funny failure clips, and streamer-friendly play created a viral friendslop loop. The app should use a Toy Rule: paint yourself into the room before the timer ends; funniest visible failure wins. around the trigger moment "Upload or choose a room photo, paint legal hiding zones and forbidden colors, start a round timer, then grade how visible each player is and export a clip-card challenge." and make the first screen communicate "A friendslop-style party toy where players draw camouflage rules on a room photo, hide, fail loudly, and export a shareable challenge card.". Build the core workflow around user-entered evidence and produce shareable camouflage challenge card. Required sections: Room photo stage; Paintable camouflage zones; 15-second rule card; Round timer; Visibility judge meter; Fail replay caption; Shareable challenge poster. Design direction: use the playful-experimental profile with playful-experimental energy, high-contrast stage lighting, bold timers, and tactile paint controls.
